title: Your 30-year-old self is *begging* you to stop these 6 things

label: STOP #1
head: Scrolling until 2am
sub: "I still can't sleep without a screen. Charge it in the kitchen."

label: STOP #2
head: Skipping the gym "just this week"
sub: "My back hurts tying my shoes. 20 minutes. Today."

label: STOP #3
head: Waiting until you feel ready
sub: "I waited 10 years. Ready never came. Start ugly."

label: STOP #4
head: Spending every peso you earn
sub: "I'm 30 with zero savings. Move 10% out the day you get paid."

label: STOP #5
head: Letting your friendships fade
sub: "I have 400 followers and nobody to call. Text one friend this week."

label: STOP #6
head: Saying "I'll start Monday"
sub: "500 Mondays in a row. Start today, and start small."

head: He can't change anything. *You still can.*
